Q4 2026

Encompass changes in the works.

Work already underway with NFM on the workflow itself, not just the tools around it.

Change of Circumstance automation

One screen that flags only what moved since the last disclosure, so a COC is caught and routed before it turns into a cure.

Validation with an audit trail

Every change to a loan term, fee or credit recorded, with who changed it and when.

Autosave

Work in the file without losing it to a timeout or a missed save.

Broader file access after approval

See and work your own files further into the process, without asking.

In progress

The work underway inside Encompass.

Everyday usability
  • Broader file access for LOs after approval
  • Branch Managers at processor-level access
  • A banner bar each user sets up their own way
  • Finicity order tracking, every invite date captured
Change of Circumstance
  • One screen for the fields that drive a COC
  • A full audit trail of what changed and who changed it
  • Loan structure and COC fields captured together
  • Autosave, once change tracking is in place
Documents & delivery
  • A UW stacking order covering all but disclosures
  • Bond stacking orders
  • One standard for what ships to the investor
  • Borrower 2 and 3 folders that build themselves
Bond & HFA loans
  • Title ordering on loans with linked HFA seconds
  • Bond DBA and mortgagee clause onto the insurance request
  • Automated 4506T setup
  • An automated Housing Counselor list
